svg.title: Trots Oudtshoorn sand heritage T-shirt front
svg.desc: Heritage front print with ostrich feather, mountain sunrise and full brand name. Intended garment colour: sand beige. Transparent background. All lettering is vector geometry; no fonts or linked images.
